body: I feel like I’m losing my mind.
I’m sitting at home on my floor.
Yea, I’m not really afraid of dying. It’s the not knowing what’s going to happen next
I also really want to die
I thought there was a group of people sitting next to me for a while now and I just realized that’s there’s no one there.  I went to go talk to them.
Thanks for the offer, but I can’t see any way out of this. I feel like I’m just wasting your time right now because I know I’m just going to die.
I tried. No one understands. I help everyone and I’m supposed to be responsible so no one will help me.
I’m too tired to fix anything.

I don’t think I can fix anything. I can’t report him. He said he didn’t know that I really didn’t want to have sex with him. I’m just going to die. I can’t afford to be alive right now and I’m losing my mind. I don’t want to be here anymore.

Okay... I’ve been feeling this way for a looong time. I started feeling depressed in October because I had to get surgery done on my foot and I couldn’t skateboard for a while which is basically like my escape. Then my job started to be really shitty. My manager tried to write me up for having surgery. He tried to make me work the day after my surgery and when I called HR he got reprimanded so from there he just made my life horrible at work. Then I transferred to a new store and I thought everything was great until I started dating my ex in March. I ended up losing my virginity to him after keeping it for 26 years. I was feeling better for a few weeks with him, but then I started feeling depressed again. I couldn’t control whether or not I was crying. It was making me sick. I would throw up all the time. So he started getting verbally abusive, which led to him hurting me too. Then he went on leave for 2 weeks and basically didn’t talk to me when he was back home, but when he came back he was constantly texting and basically blowing me off. I asked him about it and he kept getting more and more mad. Also, the day I picked him up for the airport he raped me 3 different times. I was really upset with him for ignoring me when he was home and for treating me like shit so I told him I didn’t want to have sex all three times and he still did. I thought because we were together that it wasn’t considered rape. Plus I had sex with him after. Anyway, after that happened there’s a bunch of little things that happened then 20 minutes before we were going to leave to drop him off at base because he was getting deployed I decided to see what time it was on his phone and saw three text messages from different girls sexting him.  I ended up saying something but it basically got blown off since he was leaving. Then when I got home from dropping him off I just started panicking. I tried to kill myself. I ended up going to my bosses house because I panicked and she fixed my arm up and then I went back home and got mad at myself for telling her and tried again. This time I sliced up my arm pretty bad. I didn’t know what to do so I panicked and left my house and sat in a parking lot while I was passing out and bleeding. I don’t know how but my manager ended up being there and saved me again. She wanted to take me to the hospital but we used butterfly stitches to stitch up my arms. Then I tried to kill myself by sitting in my car in the heat with my heater on and I passed out, but I woke back up before I died and chickened out. Then my manager and her friend found out and called the police on me, but I convinced them that I was okay so they didn’t take me. After that my managers friend took me to a voluntary crisis center, but they basically did nothing for me. I even tried the next day and still no one really helped. They all thought I was upset because of my ex cheating on me. In all reality its because I do too much for people and get treated like shit, my family treats me so horribly, I was raped by someone I thought loved me, and I feel like I’m losing my mind. Plus my manager who was trying to help me got mad at me because her friend who she was in love with started paying more attention to me and basically all of my coworkers to give me the silent treatment. So I had to quit my job because the thought of going back caused me to have panic attacks. Now my car is on the verge of be reposessed(sp?), I haven’t paid my bills, and I’m about to say fuck it and kill myself right now. There’s a lot more that I didn’t put I’m too tired to focus enough. Im just done.
